title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 5 — WORLD 1: A2 POWER-UP & NEW BEGINNINGS
description: Grade 5 begins with a clear step beyond elementary English: richer vocabulary, stronger grammar control, longer texts, natural listening, extended speaking and practical communication.

missions.title: Vocabulary Upgrade
missions.focus: A2 collocations, word families, high-frequency verbs, adjectives and everyday chunks

missions.title: Present Tense Precision
missions.focus: present simple vs present continuous, stative verbs, routines, temporary situations and habits

missions.title: Past Events & Stories
missions.focus: past simple and past continuous, sequence markers, interrupted actions and narrative detail

missions.title: Future Plans & Predictions
missions.focus: going to, will, present continuous for arrangements and making simple predictions

missions.title: Comparing People & Places
missions.focus: comparatives, superlatives, modifiers, preferences and supporting reasons

missions.title: Food, Shopping & Quantities
missions.focus: countable/uncountable nouns, articles, some/any, much/many, enough and shopping language

missions.title: Healthy Habits Mission
missions.focus: health vocabulary, routines, symptoms, advice and should/shouldn't

missions.title: School Life & Study Skills
missions.focus: subjects, schedules, instructions, classroom communication, study habits and learning goals

missions.title: Around Town
missions.focus: directions, public places, transport, signs, prepositions and asking for information

missions.title: A2 Conversation Lab
missions.focus: 5-minute guided conversation with follow-up questions, opinions, descriptions and personal experiences

missions.title: Reading Explorer — The New Student
missions.focus: 500–600 word narrative, main idea, details, sequence, context vocabulary and simple inference

missions.title: Listening Lab — A Busy School Day
missions.focus: 4–6 minute A2 listening with conversations, announcements, times and instructions

missions.title: Writing Lab — My Experience
missions.focus: 150–200 word connected paragraph about a past experience using sequence and linking words

missions.title: Dialogue Builder
missions.focus: building and performing natural dialogues with greetings, questions, reactions, clarification and closing

missions.title: Travel Starter Mission
missions.focus: tickets, schedules, hotel basics, directions, baggage and asking for help

missions.title: Problem Solver
missions.focus: explaining a simple problem, requesting assistance, suggesting solutions and responding politely

missions.title: Opinion & Reason Power
missions.focus: I think, I believe, I prefer, because, so, but; giving reasons and simple agreement/disagreement

missions.title: English Without Translation
missions.focus: describing unknown words, paraphrasing, examples, clarification and communication repair

missions.title: World 1 Skills Marathon
missions.focus: integrated vocabulary, grammar, reading, listening, speaking and writing review

missions.title: WORLD 1 MASTER QUEST — A2 POWER-UP
missions.focus: multi-stage assessment combining everyday dialogue, reading, listening, writing and independent speaking

content_targets.mastery: Learner enters Grade 5 able to communicate confidently about familiar topics and handle longer, more connected A2-level English with reduced translation support.
